prompt: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic on a white background showing two AI image results from the same prompt. Canvas: landscape aspect ratio, approximately 580×420 px, clean white margins. Layout: two equal vertical image panels aligned horizontally with a narrow white gutter between them; each panel has a black sans-serif heading centered above it. Use exactly 2 headings: left heading “ChatGPT Image 2”, right heading “Grok Imagine 2.0”. Left panel: a highly realistic warm-toned portrait photo of an elderly East Asian woodcarver in a cluttered traditional workshop, gray hair tied back, long white beard and mustache, weathered face with fine wrinkles, wearing dark work clothes, holding a detailed carved wooden statue close to his chest with both hands, soft window light from the left, shelves and tools blurred in the background, dusty particles in the air, documentary realism. Right panel: a more cinematic but less natural portrait of an elderly East Asian craftsman seated at a workbench in a woodworking studio, balding gray hair, deeply wrinkled face, dark shirt, carving a small wooden figure with hand tools, strong dramatic sunlight from a window, many chisels and woodworking tools standing upright behind him, wood shavings scattered across the table, high contrast shadows, slightly artificial glossy look. Include exactly 1 small blue circular overlay icon near the center-left of the right panel, with a simple white symbol inside, resembling an interface marker. Overall style: realistic photographic comparison, left image more natural and detailed, right image more stylized and dramatic. No extra captions, no watermarks beyond the single blue overlay icon, no borders except the white page background.

promptZh: 在白色背景上创建一个并排对比图，展示同一提示词生成的两个 AI 图像结果。画布：横向比例，约 580×420 像素，留有干净的白色边距。布局：两个等大的垂直图像面板水平排列，中间留有窄窄的白色间距；每个面板上方居中放置一个黑色无衬线标题。使用 2 个标题：左侧标题为“ChatGPT Image 2”，右侧标题为“Grok Imagine 2.0”。左侧面板：一张高度写实的暖色调肖像照，展示了一位在杂乱传统工坊中的东亚老年木雕匠人，灰发束在脑后，留着长长的白胡须，饱经风霜的脸上布满细纹，身穿深色工作服，双手将一个精致的木雕塑像紧贴胸前，左侧有柔和的窗光，背景中的架子和工具模糊处理，空气中有尘埃颗粒，具有纪录片式的真实感。右侧面板：一张更具电影感但自然度稍逊的肖像，展示了一位坐在木工工作室工作台前的东亚老年工匠，秃顶灰发，满脸深皱纹，身穿深色衬衫，正用手工工具雕刻一个小木人，来自窗户的强光形成戏剧性效果，身后立着许多凿子和木工工具，桌上散落着木屑，高对比度阴影，带有轻微的人工光泽感。在右侧面板的中左侧附近包含 1 个小的蓝色圆形叠加图标，内部有一个简单的白色符号，类似于界面标记。整体风格：写实摄影对比，左侧图像更自然、细节更丰富，右侧图像更具风格化和戏剧性。无需额外说明文字，除该蓝色叠加图标外无任何水印，除白色页面背景外无任何边框。
